set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols bfd traceoptions file bfd..command: set protocols bfd traceoptions file bfd.log
set protocols bfd traceoptions file bfd..explanation: Configure the tracking options for BFD protocols and specify log files.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.explanation: The name of the log file to store the tracking information for the BFD protocol.

set protocols bfd interface ge-1/0/0.explanation: Enables the BFD protocol on the specified interface.

echo-mode.explanation: Enables the echo mode of the BFD protocol on the specified interface.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.1.1/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.
